\"Maintenir\" : freelook actif tant que: "Hold": freelook active as long as the key is held (default). "Toggle": one press activates, a second deactivates.
\"Personnalisé\" = position/taille libre: "Custom" = free position/size, icon + durability text (default). "Vanilla" = fixed hotbar-style position, REAL slot + vanilla durability bar, locked HUD (not movable).
\"Sensibilité du jeu\" (défaut) : suit l: "Game sensitivity" (default): follows the game's mouse sensitivity setting, like the rest of gameplay. "Custom": ignores that setting, uses a value dedicated to freelook.
Accélère l'animation de swing (bras + it: Speeds up the swing animation (arm + held item), 1.7-style
Affiche la saturation et l'exhaustion, c: Shows saturation and exhaustion, hidden by the vanilla UI
Affiche le nombre d'images par seconde: Shows the number of frames per second
Afficher même avec un écran ouvert: Show even with a screen open
Arrondi des coins des panneaux HUD affic: Corner rounding of the HUD panels shown in-game — not the menu cards.
Couleur principale utilisée dans tout le: Main color used throughout the menu.
Divise par 2 la fréquence des textures a: Halves the update rate of animated textures (water, lava, fire...)
Désactive tout le brouillard (distance,: Disables all fog (distance, water, lava, darkness, blindness...)
Empilée verticalement (une ligne par emp: Stacked vertically (one line per slot) or side by side horizontally.
Empêche de déplacer/redimensionner cet é: Prevents moving/resizing this element in the HUD editor.
Envoie la position/orientation à Mumble: Sends position/orientation to Mumble for 3D positional audio
Espace entre le bord de la boîte et le c: Space between the box's edge and its content (X).
Space between the box's edge and its content (Y).
F11 bascule vers un plein écran fenêtré: F11 switches to a borderless windowed fullscreen (instead of native fullscreen) — stable, instant alt-tab/app switching
FOV, Zoom, Hurt Cam, Sprint/Sneak, Satur: FOV, Zoom, Hurt Cam, Sprint/Sneak, Saturation, Darkness, Fog, Pumpkin, Clear vision
Force l'heure affichée (soleil/lune/ciel: Forces the displayed time (sun/moon/sky), without changing the real server time
Garde le HUD visible dans les écrans de: Keeps the HUD visible in container screens (chest, furnace, crafting table...).
Garde le HUD visible quand l'inventaire: Keeps the HUD visible when the player inventory (E key, no container open) is open.
Garde le HUD visible quand la zone de sa: Keeps the HUD visible when the chat input field is open.
Incline l'épée tenue en 1ère personne: Tilts the sword held in first person
L'item tenu ne suit plus le regard, comm: The held item no longer follows the view, like in 1.7
Langue de l'interface du launcher (menu,: Language of the launcher interface (menu, settings, HUD...). Some advanced screens (Modrinth browser) remain in French for now.
Limite la plus zoomée atteignable en scr: Limits the closest zoom reachable by scrolling while zoomed (scroll up = zoom in further).
Maintenir (ou basculer) une touche pour: Hold (or toggle) a key to look around without changing the character's facing direction (OptiFine-style).
Maintenir une touche zoome en douceur, s: Hold a key to zoom smoothly, scroll while zoomed to go further (Zoomify-style)
Masque/simplifie les pseudos/hologrammes: Hides/simplifies nametags/holograms based on distance — useful in crowded areas or with many server holograms
Ne recalcule les nuages \"Fancy\" que pé: Only recomputes "Fancy" clouds periodically instead of every frame (no effect in Fast/Off mode)
Doesn't render chests/furnaces/signs... beyond a given distance
Ne rend pas les faces cachées des modèle: Doesn't render hidden faces of living entity models — disable if a mob/resource pack shows a hole
Ne rend pas les faces cachées du modèle: Doesn't render hidden faces of the player model — FPS gain, disable if a skin shows a hole
Ne rend pas les particules (fumée, flamm: Doesn't render particles (smoke, flames, debris) beyond a given distance — big gain with mass explosions/lava
Niveau de zoom appliqué à l'appui sur la: Zoom level applied when the key is pressed — see "Max zoom FOV" for the limit reachable by scrolling.
Nombre de threads pour reconstruire les: Number of threads to rebuild modified chunks (vanilla is locked to 2, regardless of CPU)
Palette générale de l'interface — sombre: General interface palette — dark (default) or light.
Permet de faire swing l'épée en bloquant: Allows swinging the sword while blocking, like in 1.7
Ping quand mon pseudo est mentionné: Ping when my name is mentioned
Ping quand ton pseudo est mentionné + re: Pings when your name is mentioned + groups repeated messages
Quelle main afficher pour l'objet en mai: Which hand to show for the held item (1.9+ only — ignored on 1.8.9, which has no off hand).
Ralentissement du sneak appliqué progres: Sneak slowdown applied gradually instead of instantly
Ralentit la rotation de la caméra propor: Slows down camera rotation proportionally to the current zoom level, for a consistent feel (100% = full spyglass-style compensation, 0% = unchanged sensitivity).
Rechercher et installer un resource pack: Search for and install a resource pack or shader pack
Rend une seule copie par item au sol, pe: Renders a single copy per dropped item, regardless of stack size
Reste visible pendant le chat, l'inventa: Stays visible during chat, inventory, or any other screen (except our own menus).
Retire l'effet Ténèbres (Warden / Sculk: Removes the Darkness effect (Warden / Sculk Shrieker) as soon as it appears
Retire l'overlay de vision de la citroui: Removes the vision overlay of a carved pumpkin worn on the head
Retire le brouillard teinté et le givre: Removes tinted fog and the frost from water, lava and powder snow
Supprime le tremblement de caméra à la p: Removes camera shake when taking damage
Survole une shulker box dans un inventai: Hover a shulker box in an inventory while holding Shift to see its contents.
Taille de toute la boîte (largeur ET hau: Size of the whole box (width AND height together, never one without the other).
Teinte l'écran quand la vie descend sous: Tints the screen when health drops below a threshold
Temps pour atteindre le niveau de zoom c: Time to smoothly reach the target zoom level, both on press and release — 0 = instant (original behavior).
Touche qui ouvre/ferme le menu YuyuFrame: Key that opens/closes the YuyuFrame menu in-game.
Transparence des panneaux HUD affichés e: Transparency of the HUD panels shown in-game (FPS, ping, coordinates...) — not the menu cards.
Un appui sur la touche sneak bascule l'é: Pressing the sneak key toggles the state instead of holding it
Un appui sur la touche sprint bascule l': Pressing the sprint key toggles the state instead of holding it
Utilisée seulement si \"Sensibilité\" ci: Only used if "Sensitivity" above is set to "Custom" — same unit as the game's sensitivity slider (percentage, 50% = game default).
Variation de FOV par cran de molette pen: FOV change per scroll step while zoomed.
Échelle générale du menu (cartes, texte,: Overall menu scale (cards, text, buttons, settings...) — not the size of HUD elements shown in-game, which are set individually (see each module).
Éclaire toute la scène au maximum, ignor: Fully lights the whole scene, ignores darkness
